topics.question_text: How should government balance what it collects in taxes against what it spends on public services?

stances.text: Significantly raise taxes on wealthy people and large companies to fund more public services
Moderately raise taxes on wealthy people and large companies to fund existing services
Keep the current tax system mostly as-is, with targeted adjustments — closing loopholes or granting narrow relief
Cut taxes broadly, including the main rates most people pay
Cut taxes as far as possible and shrink what government does
